name: mediterranean-beach-green-dress-goddess
image_vibe: Bright Mediterranean summer, confident luxury vacation, vibrant sunlit color
image_purpose: Create a polished vacation fashion portrait for lifestyle/social content.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic fashion beach portrait on a sunny European pebble beach.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult blonde woman with long flowing blonde hair and sun-kissed natural skin, wearing a lime-green crochet summer dress layered over a white bikini with secure coverage, a matching green headband, black sunglasses, large gold starfish earrings, and a gold chain belt. Her pose is confident and carefree.
prompt.composition_elements: Fashion portrait on a pebble beach with turquoise water, beachgoers, seaside buildings, and dramatic green cliffs in the background. Keep the green dress, white bikini layer, accessories, and Mediterranean coastline as the visual hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural midday sunlight, crisp highlights on skin and crochet texture, shallow depth of field, vibrant luxury summer vacation atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution fashion photography, shallow depth of field, sharp natural texture, realistic crochet, skin, water, pebble, and cliff detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic fashion beach portrait of an original adult blonde woman on a sunny European pebble beach. She has long flowing blonde hair and natural sun-kissed skin, and wears a lime-green crochet summer dress layered over a white bikini with secure coverage, matching green headband, black sunglasses, large gold starfish earrings, and a gold chain belt. Give her a confident carefree pose. Show turquoise Mediterranean water, beachgoers, seaside buildings, and dramatic green cliffs under bright natural midday sunlight with crisp highlights, shallow depth of field, realistic crochet and coastal texture, and a luxury summer vacation aesthetic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent dress, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source Mediterranean beach reference
assets.usage: Use only for beach setting, green dress, accessories, coastline, and daylight; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the lime-green crochet dress over white bikini, green headband, starfish earrings, gold belt, Mediterranean coast, and bright luxury mood. Keep the subject original adult and swimwear securely covered.

changes: Clarified an original adult subject and secure swimwear coverage.
Added identity and safety exclusions while preserving the fashion-beach concept.
